regime_context: China A-shares show an extreme one-narrative tape: Coal is the sole eligible leader (rank 1, score 0.992) but carries a low durability bar (0.52) and a mean-revert Hurst tag, while only 2 of 22 themes clear the absolute-trend gate and the gate historically did NOT hold on this market (gate_helps=false). theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only theme that is both rank-1 and trend-gate eligible, and it is not crowded (crowding_z 0.59). The lean rests entirely on the absolute-trend gate leg (eligible=true) plus clean positioning texture; the durability leg is weak and the Hurst tag says mean-revert, so this is a momentum-carry lean, not a fundamental call.
theses.dissent: The trend gate did_NOT_hold_here on China A-shares history (gate_helps=false), so eligibility may be a coincident label rather than drawdown protection, and the mean-revert Hurst tag plus low durability (0.52) suggest the leadership can reverse quickly.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS underperforms the CSI 300 benchmark over any 10-day stretch before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are rank-3 and trend-gate eligible with the highest durability (0.83) and full breadth (1.0), but they are the most crowded theme in the book (crowding_z 1.83, crowded=true). Under the guardrails, crowding is a cap/down-size caution only — expressed here as a directional lean away from adding — while the high durability argues against a hard avoid.
theses.dissent: Banks have the strongest durability and breadth in the entire ranked universe, and crowding has no validated basket-level forward edge — declining to add may forgo the one genuinely robust trend in the tape.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS outperforms the CSI 300 benchmark by 3% or more over the check-by horizon while its crowding_z stays above 1.5
